text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During the summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... How was that, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Looking great! Let's do one more run!
Looking great! How about one more run?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek has been in top form lately.
At this rate, we're sure to see fantastic results once training camp ends.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my, is it that late already?
I got a little too carried away~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ I've been feeling so wonderful lately.
Even though I finished today's quota, I feel like I could keep going.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right.
Training camp is still far from over, after all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's nothing at all.
Today's training was just so fulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It feels like my body has fully adapted
to the training regimens you design for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Though I suppose that's only natural,
since it's a routine you crafted with so much care just for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A trainer who did such a good job
deserves a special reward♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ It looks like there's a summer festival happening nearby.
Would you like to go check it out together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking Super Creek up on her offer,
we headed over to the summer festival grounds.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, so many children.
They all look like they're having fun, how wonderful~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Shall we look around?
...My, there are so many food stalls, I don't know where to look first~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've been training all day, so you must be starving, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy some food and find a quiet spot
with a nice view to eat together♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Super Creek and I browsed the festival stalls, buying treats along the way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As night fell, the summer festival became even livelier.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, the crowd has gotten quite thick, hasn't it~?
We should be careful not to get separated...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—No sooner had she said that than a large group surged in,
sweeping Super Creek off in the opposite direction!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, oh dear~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...!
Hold onto...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clasping Super Creek's hand tightly,
we managed to weave our way out of the surging crowd.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We should be safe all the way out here.
Fufu, that was quite the ordeal~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, holding hands so tightly kept us from getting separated.
Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Glancing down, I realized Super Creek and I were still holding hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I quickly let go of her hand...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no need to panic like that.
After all, you were the one who told me to take your hand, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, were you trying to say something earlier too?
Come to think of it, were you about to say something back there too?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, was I?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, let's talk later and eat before it gets cold.
The takoyaki will lose its heat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Super Creek and I shared the takoyaki while gazing out at the nighttime ocean.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A peaceful silence settled over us...
After watching the waves roll in and out a few times, she finally broke the quiet.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —About earlier...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um... about you asking to hold hands.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth... I was actually about to say the exact same thing.
But you beat me to it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Back there, Trainer...
you looked so very dependable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Ever since the day we met,
you've grown into such an admirable person... It makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basking in Super Creek's gentle, tender gaze,
a swelling desire to live up to her trust welled up within me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... um...
Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You have such a serious look on your face...
while you've got takoyaki sauce stuck right beside your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flustered, I reached into my pocket for a handkerchief.
When suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Stop right there. Hold on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without giving me a chance to protest,
Super Creek gently wiped the sauce from my cheek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...There, all gone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you remember?
A while ago, you asked me if there was anything I wanted from you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I just thought of something.
Will you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
From here on, you'll gain so much more experience
and grow into an even more remarkable Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, even if you keep becoming more and more incredible...
Will you still let me spoil you forever and ever?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Please take good care of me, always and forever.
